1920.s: The feast it was nigh, and the mass it was nigher, When before the fair princess low louted a squire, And delivered a garment unseemly to view, With sword cut and spear thrust all hacked and pierced through, All rent and all tattered, all clotted with blood, With foam of the horses, with dust, and with mud.

1920.s: You will forgive the lowly room which entours you, and the unseemly garments which in haste I ordered, guessing at what you might require.
